{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0356","text":"Subject: Meeting Request: Thursday, 2:00–2:30 PM, Room 214, Haldane Hall

Dear Colleagues,

I am writing to ask that the following members of the search committee hold Thursday from 2:00 to 2:30 PM in Room 214, Haldane Hall:

Dr. Kemi Carvalho
Dr. Callum Oyelaran
Dr. Oskar Varga
Dr. Odette Cho
Ms. Maeve Pruitt
Dr. Esme Jovanovic

This follows the final on-campus visit on Wednesday. Please bring your completed evaluation rubrics and any notes you took during the teaching demonstration and the research talk. Dr. Carvalho, as chair, will lead the session. The Dean's office has asked for the committee's recommendation by Friday at noon, so we have little room to reschedule. If you cannot attend in person, please tell me by Wednesday evening so that I can arrange a video link. Please do not send your written comments in place of attending.

A few unrelated items while I have your attention:

- Visitor parking in Lot C will be closed Thursday morning for resurfacing. Please use the Elm Street garage. I can validate tickets at the department office.
- Lunch for the candidate on Wednesday is confirmed at the Faculty Club for 12:15. Dr. Cho and Dr. Varga, you are listed as hosts.
- We will be celebrating Ms. Pruitt's birthday in the main office on Friday at 3:00. Cards are circulating, so please sign discreetly.

Thank you for your continued service on this committee.

Kind regards,

Bianca
Department Administrator
Department of History
